name: Magic Exposure 2
source:
After the events surrounding the magic camera, Erika and Bianca's seemingly perfect relationship runs into trouble, leading them to break up. As Bianca processes her feelings, her life takes another turn for the worse when she encounters a second mysterious magic camera and meets Lúcia, the intelligent and polished president of the school council. Will fate rekindle her love for Erika? Or will it lead her down new paths with the newcomer?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4092410/Magic_Exposure_2__Yuri_Visual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
